Maya (People Ops): Quick flag for managers — we're getting about a dozen reviewer conflicts popping up (PTO, interview clashes, timezone overlap). Please confirm explicit backup reviewers in Lattice by EOD, and paste the backup info here if you need us to update permissions.
Sam (ENG Manager): On it. Two of my reviewers are scheduled for interviews next Wed. Can I list the recruiting lead as backup or does it have to be another manager?
Maya (People Ops): Backup can be another manager or senior IC who has already completed reviewer training. If it's recruiting, we need a manager-level alternate to approve ratings.
Tao (SRE): FYI — our on-call rotation might block one reviewer on Friday morning (US-EAST). If someone picks up their slot, can they be marked as "acting reviewer" in the comment? We need the audit trail for calibration.
Maya (People Ops): Yes, please use this format in the review comment: `Acting reviewer: Name (reason) — original reviewer: Name`. We'll rely on that for the calibration packet.
Noor (Recruiting): Heads-up 4cc 0 interviews next week across teams — happy to move candidate slots if that helps reviewers. Ping me with the time ranges and I'll coordinate.
Sam (ENG Manager): I'll add backups now. One more question: if a reviewer is swapped after they've already submitted a draft rating, do we require the new reviewer to re-run the form, or just add an amendment?
Maya (People Ops): If the draft rating exists, the incoming reviewer should open the review, update the "reviewer note" section with their assessment, and add a short comment `re-reviewed by X on <date>`. No need to duplicate entries. We reserve reopening only for major changes.
Tao (SRE): Can we get a short checklist link for backups so everyone follows the same calibration language? Last cycle the writeups varied a lot.
Maya (People Ops): Yup. Quick checklist (paste this verbatim into the reviewer note):
```
- Confirmed self-assessment read
- Evaluated against rubric (impact / ownership / craft)
- Noted 1 strength + 1 growth example
- Marked any calibration flags: "borderline", "underscored", "overstated"
- Added 1-2 sentence rating rationale
```
Also uploading two redacted borderline examples to the shared folder in 30m.
Noor (Recruiting): If managers need interviews moved, I can block 2-hour windows for backup reviewers only. Prefer managers DM me with names + times.
Sam (ENG Manager): Done 44d Added backups for Team Orion: Leila (backup, CET) and Marcus (backup, PST). Leila is on PTO Thurs AM so Marcus will cover then.
people-ops-bot: Reminder: "Submit reviewer backups" scheduled in 10 hours. :bell:
Maya (People Ops): Thanks Sam 44f Please ensure backups have access to the review docs. If not, DM me and I'll grant temp access.
Tao (SRE): I'll try to join the optional evening calibration slot if there are any SRE borderline cases.
Maya (People Ops): Optional drop-ins tonight: 18:00 CET / 09:00 PT — join for quick clarifications. If you can't make it and still have conflicts after EOD, DM me and cc people-ops@redwood.com and we'll triage. Thanks everyone!
